## How to Use These Guides

### Print Distribution
1. Print the relevant PDFs for each user role
2. Distribute with login credentials
3. Keep copies at workstations for reference

### Digital Distribution
- Email PDFs to team members
- Upload to shared drive or intranet
- Print-on-demand from company portal

### Customization
The markdown source files are in `docs/` — you can edit them to:
- Add company-specific instructions
- Include local contact information
- Add screenshots/custom images
- Adjust terminology to match your business

To regenerate PDFs after editing:
```bash
python generate_pdfs.py
```
